notes: CLI / harness catalog for universal-agentic-setup. tier: core = installed by default; optional = opt-in. Install commands per OS family; never embed secrets.

tools.name: ripgrep
tools.why: Fast gitignore-aware search used by most agents.

tools.name: uv
tools.why: Python/tool manager; prerequisite for many agent tools.

tools.name: fzf
tools.why: Fuzzy picker for history, files, hosts.

tools.name: zoxide
tools.post: Shell init line must be added to the user's profile manually (PowerShell: Invoke-Expression (& { (zoxide init powershell | Out-String) })).

tools.name: lazygit
tools.why: Git TUI for reviewing agent commits.

tools.name: just
tools.why: One canonical command runner per repo for agents.

tools.name: ccusage
tools.why: Token/cost reports for 18 agent CLIs from local logs (no omp source yet).

tools.name: repomix
tools.why: Pack a repo into one token-counted file with secret exclusion.

tools.name: rtk
tools.why: Compresses shell tool output 60-90% before it reaches the model.
tools.caution: `rtk init -g --agent <agent>` writes hooks into the agent's config; lossy by design (use `rtk proxy` to bypass).

tools.name: cass
tools.why: Cross-agent session search index (omp connector, SSH multi-machine sync).

install.windows: scoop bucket add dicklesworthstone https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/scoop-bucket; scoop install dicklesworthstone/cass

tools.caution: Indexes full transcripts (may include secrets); keep the index local, alpha software.

tools.name: ccmanager
tools.why: Windows-friendly manager for parallel Claude/Codex/Gemini/OpenCode sessions (no tmux).

tools.name: beads (bd)
tools.why: Dependency-aware task tracker shared by agents across machines (Dolt sync).
